entities.summary: Joseph Stella was an Italian-born American Futurist painter best known for his depictions of industrial America, especially his images of the Brooklyn Bridge. He is also associated with the American Precisionist movement of the 1910s–1940s. Joseph Stella was a painters & sculptors from Muro Lucano (1877-06-13, Muro Lucano–1946-11-05). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
